title: Solitude in Motion
description: An evocative 35mm film exploration of speed, silence, and machine harmony filmed through the winding mountain passes of the Swiss Alps at dawn.
challenge: Capture high-velocity vehicular dynamics in sub-zero alpine conditions with strictly natural golden hour lighting.
approach: We rigged ARRI Alexa 35 cinema cameras to custom precision chase rigs, utilizing Cooke Anamorphic glass for distinct lens flares and authentic film texture.
results: Over 4.2M organic impressions across digital broadcast channels and Cannes Lions shortlist for Cinematography.

title: Astral Luminescence
description: A sensory brand anthem navigating the frontier of low-light cinematography in the nocturnal obsidian landscapes of Iceland.
challenge: Showcase true extreme zero-lux sensor fidelity while maintaining an ethereal, museum-grade aesthetic.
approach: Captured under the northern aurora with specialized custom anamorphic primes calibrated for high-contrast astronomical gradients.
results: Selected as Sony's global launch campaign centerpiece across 40+ international markets.

title: Pulse Zero
description: Intense, tactile visual pacing synchronized with biometric rhythms, portraying Olympic sprinters breaking kinetic barriers in ultra high-speed slow motion.
challenge: Shoot athlete movement at 1000fps with bespoke moving lighting arrays synced precisely to runner stride frequency.
approach: Engineered a proprietary high-speed tracking cable dolly and Phantom Flex4K camera system inside an abandoned brutalist velodrome.
results: Tripled digital engagement metrics across Instagram and TikTok during campaign launch week.

title: Velvet Obsidian
description: An opulent noir study of draped silk, sharp geometric shadows, and Parisian midnight architecture.
challenge: Create a high-fashion editorial film without standard beauty lighting fixtures, relying on architectural chiaroscuro.
approach: Shot on 16mm Kodak Vision3 film stock pushed 2 stops to achieve velvety, rich organic grain textures.
results: Debuted at Paris Fashion Week digital exhibition with featured editorial coverage in Vogue and Dazed.

title: Hyperion Echoes
description: A surrealist, dreamlike visual journey exploring psychological duality with practical pyro effects and optical prism distortion.
challenge: Execute seamless practical transitions between burning landscape sets and underwater acoustic chambers.
approach: Built custom submerged glass optical tanks in studio and utilized vintage Soviet anamorphic lenses with flare flares.
results: Nominated for Best Independent Art Direction at UK Music Video Awards (UKMVA).

title: Chrono Heritage
description: Macro-cinematography exposing the micromechanical ballet of tourbillon movement hand-assembly in the Vallée de Joux.
challenge: Extreme optical magnification at 10x ratio without losing cinematic depth or lighting nuance.
approach: Utilized Laowa 24mm Probe lenses on sub-millimeter motorized robotic motion control arms.
results: Generated over 18M views across digital luxury watch media and private collector screenings.
